title: NormalizedConfigurations
description: Step 3 output: clean, one-row-per-part-number configuration table for a part family, joined to the Step 1 feature template's parameter symbols.

catalog_id.description: Stable id for this catalog row set. Conventionally matches template_id.

source_template_id.description: Step 1 template_id this catalog was derived from.

source_component_id.description: MISUMI component folder id (e.g. 110300324920) used as the primary scrape source.

parameter_symbols.description: Ordered list of dimension symbols this catalog exposes, drawn from the template's parameter symbols.

variant.description: Variant label parsed from configuration column when present; 'standard' when not.

values.description: Map of parameter_symbol -> value. Numeric values stored as numbers; thread specs (e.g. 'M5') as strings; missing values as null.

source_table_idx.description: Index into the original specs.json tables array this row came from.

extraction.description: Provenance / diagnostics metadata about how the catalog was extracted.
